root_cause.summary: Backend API is not listening on the configured API base URL. Frontend is reachable on localhost, but POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/auth/login fails with net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.

checks.evidence: No VITE_API_BASE_URL is set in root .env; frontend uses default http://127.0.0.1:8000.
backend/app/main.py allows http://127.0.0.1:5173, http://localhost:5173, http://127.0.0.1:5174 and http://localhost:5174. Browser failure is ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED before CORS can be evaluated.
Frontend and API base URL are both http:// localhost/127.0.0.1.
Frontend calls http://127.0.0.1:8000 directly; no proxy was involved in the failing request.
docker API is not reachable; docker_engine pipe is missing. Local DB ports 5432 and 5433 are not listening.
GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/health and GET http://127.0.0.1:8013/health fail with connection error.
GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/auth/me fails with connection error.
Playwright captured console error: Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.
Playwright captured requestfailed for POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/auth/login with net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.

immediate: Start or restart frontend with matching API base URL: npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1.
Open the frontend via the same host family as Vite serves; currently localhost works, 127.0.0.1 did not for the active Vite process.
verify: GET http://127.0.0.1:8000/health/db returns healthy DB status.
POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/auth/login returns JSON instead of net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED.
Browser Network tab no longer shows refused requests to 127.0.0.1:8000.
fix.configuration_note: If backend is intentionally started on a different port, set VITE_API_BASE_URL to that exact http URL before starting Vite.

gate_impact.m3a: Runtime environment is not currently gate-verifiable. This does not change the existing M3a RC artifact, but a new frontend truth run would fail until backend and DB are running.
gate_impact.m4: Blocks M4 runtime validation because auth, upload, lifecycle and diagnostics API paths cannot be reached.
gate_impact.m5: No M5 implementation impact; M5 remains blocked by M4 and existing Pre-M5 decision.
